今之海寇備矣，而愚亦與執事之憂者，何也？蓋今之議者，戰也；而愚之所見者，則守也。風波迅速，盜舟獨宜，追兵雖設，何益耶？近濱海之郡，轉募舟師，皆在他邑，雇直旣寡，將權復輕，利則進，不利則退。海洋之戰，孰從而稽之耶？及以功報，又類非寇也。稱戰皆虛事，議守則實功。其要惟在募土兵以守之而已矣。凡言戰者，皆由於武弁之喜功。守則民蒙安靜之福，而若輩無以自見，故甘心爲之，他不暇計。即如所募之舟，直輕價厚，而其人率多悍徒，應募而來，將圖他利，向賊死戰，豈其心耶？區區募資，知不足以係之者，又陵擾居民，莫之能制。「虜來猶可，尹來殺我」，此之謂也。苟惟專爲守計，改募土兵，則所守之地，即其室廬桑梓之區，其樂爲守，且偵
translation_en:
…indeed. Would this not move them so that they could not but act, and impel them so that they could not but comply? Work within their own territory, employ their own people, and encourage them toward what they are bound to pursue: this is what is meant by taking advantage of circumstances and guiding them to their benefit.

Preparations against today’s maritime raiders are in place. Why, then, do I, in my humble judgment, share your concern? It is because those offering proposals today advocate battle, whereas I favor defense. Amid swift winds and waves, the raiders’ vessels alone are well suited to the conditions. Even if pursuing forces are provided, what use are they? Recently, coastal prefectures have turned to recruiting naval forces, all from other districts. Their pay is meager, and their commanders’ authority is weak. When conditions favor them, they advance; when conditions do not, they retreat. Who can follow them out to sea and verify their battles? When they report their achievements, moreover, those they have attacked generally turn out not to have been raiders. Claims of battle are all empty affairs; plans for defense yield real achievements. The essential point is simply to recruit local troops to defend the coast.

All this talk of battle stems from military officers’ eagerness for merit. Defense brings the people the blessing of peace and quiet, but gives such men no opportunity to distinguish themselves. Thus they willingly pursue battle, with no time to consider anything else. Take the vessels recruited for service: their hire is cheap, yet their price is high [?]. Their crews are mostly violent fellows who enlist in pursuit of other profits. How could fighting the raiders to the death be their intention? The paltry recruitment funds plainly cannot bind them to service. They also bully and harass the inhabitants, and no one can restrain them. This is precisely what is meant by the saying, “When the invaders come, we can still endure it; when Yin comes, he kills us.”

If we concentrated exclusively on defense and recruited local troops instead, the land they defended would be the very place of their homes and native communities. They would gladly defend it; moreover, reconnaissance…

title: 嘉靖二十五年廣東鄉試錄
text:
戍未甞出境而日有所給則德我者深雖
半其直亦所願者況臨之者即其本籍之
長吏統屬既定號令易行視他募之樂則
就不樂則去飄忽不可羈者又難同日語
矣防守之眾一呼即集盜賊何虞耶亦甞
有病此者則曰其人不善戰也殊不知濱
海之人地利素熟壯年受募精習奚難顧
所以簡教振作之者何如耳不亦事舉而
不見其敝民利而不見其害者乎投所欲
===
違所惡而責以所不難故亦曰因勢而利
導之也蓋大酋既撫則小醜之竊發者不
虞矣邏守既嚴則島嶼之棲泊者無所矣
此蓋機與要之說也至其原本則治人治
法之說又所當留意者乎若夫兵食之宜
阨塞之要威信之實練習之方固有槩於
中而未敢盡也惟執事裁其可否
punctuated: 戍未甞出境，而日有所給，則德我者深。雖半其直，亦所願者。況臨之者，即其本籍之長吏，統屬既定，號令易行，視他募之樂則就、不樂則去、飄忽不可羈者，又難同日語矣。防守之眾，一呼即集，盜賊何虞耶？亦甞有病此者，則曰其人不善戰也。殊不知濱海之人，地利素熟，壯年受募，精習奚難？顧所以簡教振作之者何如耳。不亦事舉而不見其敝，民利而不見其害者乎？投所欲，違所惡，而責以所不難，故亦曰因勢而利導之也。蓋大酋既撫，則小醜之竊發者不虞矣；邏守既嚴，則島嶼之棲泊者無所矣。此蓋機與要之說也。至其原本，則治人治法之說，又所當留意者乎？若夫兵食之宜、阨塞之要、威信之實、練習之方，固有槩於中，而未敢盡也。惟執事裁其可否。
translation_en:
…while on garrison duty they never leave their home territory and receive provisions daily, so their gratitude to us will be profound. Even at half the pay, they would willingly serve. Moreover, those overseeing them would be the senior local officials of their own native jurisdictions. With the chain of command already established, orders would be easy to carry out. They could hardly be compared with men recruited elsewhere, who enlist when it pleases them and leave when it does not, drifting about beyond restraint. The defenders would assemble at a single call: what fear need there be of bandits? Some have indeed found fault with this proposal, saying that these men are not skilled in battle. They fail to understand that coastal people are already thoroughly familiar with the advantages of the terrain. Recruited in their prime, how could they find it difficult to acquire proficiency through training? It depends only on how they are selected, instructed, and inspired. Would this not accomplish the task without attendant abuses, benefiting the people without harming them? By meeting their wishes, avoiding what they dislike, and requiring of them what is not difficult, one may thus be said to guide them advantageously in accordance with the circumstances.

Once the great chieftains have been pacified, there will be no need to fear stealthy outbreaks by lesser miscreants; once patrols and defenses are strict, those who shelter and anchor among the islands will have nowhere to do so. These, then, are the considerations concerning opportunities and essentials. As for their underlying foundation, should attention not also be paid to the question of men capable of governing and methods of good government? Regarding suitable arrangements for troops and provisions, the strategic importance of narrow passes, the substance of authority and trustworthiness, and methods of military training, I do have a general conception in mind, but have not ventured to set it all forth. I ask only that you judge which of these proposals are acceptable.

title: 嘉靖二十五年廣東鄉試錄
text:
廣東鄉試錄後序
洪惟我
聖天子御極之二十有五年秋八
月廣東鄉試事旣訖萬斛不
佞敢諗於諸士子曰自萬斛
獲與斯役嘗竊自懼以為
國家取士于文務莫重焉乃今
===
持獨見之是一旦取素所不
知者七十五人於數千之中
其皆賢才矣乎萬有一焉非
賢與才也其何以逃罪苟曰
拔十得五斯已矣此可以恕
人而未宜自諉也夫循言識
實聖哲惟難何則其達之詞
punctuated:
廣東鄉試錄後序

洪惟我聖天子御極之二十有五年秋八月，廣東鄉試事旣訖，萬斛不佞，敢諗於諸士子曰：「自萬斛獲與斯役，嘗竊自懼，以為國家取士于文，務莫重焉。乃今持獨見之是，一旦取素所不知者七十五人於數千之中，其皆賢才矣乎？萬有一焉非賢與才也，其何以逃罪？苟曰拔十得五，斯已矣，此可以恕人，而未宜自諉也。夫循言識實，聖哲惟難。何則？其達之詞
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Guangdong Provincial Examination

In the eighth month of autumn in the twenty-fifth year of our sage Son of Heaven’s reign, the Guangdong Provincial Examination had concluded. I, Wan Hu, unworthy as I am, ventured to address the candidates:

“Since being granted a part in this undertaking, I have privately felt apprehensive, reflecting that among the state’s responsibilities none is weightier than selecting men through their writing. Now, relying on what my own judgment alone deems right, I have at one stroke selected seventy-five men previously unknown to me from among several thousand. Are they all men of virtue and ability? If even one should lack virtue and ability, how could I escape blame? If one were to say, ‘Choose ten and obtain five worthy men—that will suffice,’ this might excuse others, but I ought not use it to absolve myself. To discern the substance of a person from his words is difficult even for sages and wise men. Why is this? The words through which he expresses himself …

title: 嘉靖二十五年廣東鄉試錄
text:
也未必皆若其所存也是故
躁而詞莊貪而詞介暴而詞
溫懦而詞勁冥而詞昭是將
循奚道以決之今惟其文取
耳矣庸知其中無前所云若
人也旣又自解曰粵山海阻
奧鍾竒毓秀奮舒景光後先
===
相望矧自
明聖建極垂範彰明好惡登崇茂
實甄陶漸漬益醇以熙薄海
内外罔不泳游
聖澤砥礪于名行粵多才傑茍在
士籍宜無庸違而况七十五
人者尤其庠校之英乎此萬
punctuated: 也，未必皆若其所存也。是故躁而詞莊，貪而詞介，暴而詞溫，懦而詞勁，冥而詞昭，是將循奚道以決之？今惟其文取耳矣，庸知其中無前所云若人也？旣又自解曰：「粵山海阻奧，鍾竒毓秀，奮舒景光，後先相望。矧自明聖建極垂範，彰明好惡，登崇茂實，甄陶漸漬，益醇以熙，薄海内外罔不泳游聖澤，砥礪于名行。粵多才傑，茍在士籍，宜無庸違，而况七十五人者，尤其庠校之英乎？」此萬
translation_en:
…need not all accord with what they hold within. Thus, the impetuous may write with gravity, the greedy with integrity, the violent with gentleness, the timid with vigor, and the benighted with clarity. By what path, then, can one reach a judgment? Now we select them solely on their writing. How can we know that among them there are none like those just described?

Then I consoled myself again, saying: “Guangdong, secluded behind mountains and seas, gathers extraordinary qualities and nurtures outstanding talent. Men who display their brilliance have appeared one after another. Moreover, since our enlightened and sagely sovereign established the supreme standard and handed down his example, clearly manifested his approval and disapproval, and promoted those of abundant substantive merit, his molding and gradual influence have brought ever greater integrity and flourishing. Throughout the realm and beyond, to the shores of the seas, all bask in his sagely beneficence and discipline themselves in reputation and conduct. Guangdong has many talented and outstanding men. Those enrolled as students should surely neither be mediocre nor stray from the proper way; how much more so these seventy-five men, the very finest of their schools!” This … [the page ends with 萬, “ten thousand”; its connection is unclear here][?]…

title: 嘉靖二十五年廣東鄉試錄
text:
斛心口自語之實非面謾也
夫事之輕重世之榮辱恒繫
乎其人是舉也誠得一人焉
振于德業天下且將視之若
泰山與華袞也又况乎七十
五人者皆能有聞也其弗益
榮以重乎使有一人焉負厥
===
瑕疵天下且將以爲口實矣
又况乎或不幸而有二三其
人也其弗益輕以辱乎夫宴
以鹿鳴導以計偕賓之以盛
禮固將期之以大效也上之
必能黼黻
鴻猷協和
punctuated:
斛心口自語之實，非面謾也。

夫事之輕重，世之榮辱，恒繫乎其人。是舉也，誠得一人焉，振于德業，天下且將視之若泰山與華袞也。又况乎七十五人者皆能有聞也，其弗益榮以重乎？使有一人焉，負厥瑕疵，天下且將以爲口實矣。又况乎或不幸而有二三其人也，其弗益輕以辱乎？

夫宴以鹿鳴，導以計偕，賓之以盛禮，固將期之以大效也。上之必能黼黻鴻猷，協和
translation_en:
…words truly spoken from my own heart [?], not empty flattery offered to your faces.

The weight or insignificance of an undertaking, and its honor or disgrace in the world, invariably depend on the people involved. If this examination truly obtains even one man distinguished in virtue and accomplishment, the world will regard it as having the weight of Mount Tai and the honor of a splendid ceremonial robe. How much more so if all seventy-five men attain distinction! Will it not gain still greater honor and weight? If even one man bears some blemish or fault, the world will seize upon it as grounds for criticism. How much more so if, unfortunately, there are two or three such men! Will it not become still less esteemed and more disgraced?

We feast them at the Deer Call banquet, guide them toward their journey to the capital with the tribute mission, and receive them as guests with magnificent ceremony, precisely because we expect great achievements from them. The best among them will surely lend splendor to the grand imperial designs and bring into harmony…

title: 嘉靖二十五年廣東鄉試錄
text:
神化次之必能輸誠殫慮輯寧民
社忠功義烈昭昭乎若揭日
月盈天壤斯庶乎仰答
洪造萬分之一乃無負主司遴選
之意苟惟祿與位焉是崇是
圖其究也罔所底止有司者
將持尺寸議其後不但眛眛
===
已也夫施厚而報薄俊延而
鄙卻榮出而辱歸將謂之何
古人有言行萬里者始跬步
鹿鳴之歌固
巖廊之跬步而輕重榮辱之兆
端也夫八音不諧則至樂不
全水火不積則光炎不博跡
punctuated: 神化，次之必能輸誠殫慮，輯寧民社，忠功義烈，昭昭乎若揭日月、盈天壤。斯庶乎仰答洪造萬分之一，乃無負主司遴選之意。苟惟祿與位焉是崇是圖，其究也罔所底止。有司者將持尺寸議其後，不但眛眛已也。夫施厚而報薄，俊延而鄙卻，榮出而辱歸，將謂之何？古人有言：「行萬里者始跬步。」鹿鳴之歌，固巖廊之跬步，而輕重榮辱之兆端也。夫八音不諧，則至樂不全；水火不積，則光炎不博。跡
translation_en:
…the divine transforming influence. Those of the next rank must be able to offer their wholehearted devotion and exhaust their deliberations in bringing peace to the people and their communities. Their loyal achievements and righteous deeds should shine as brightly as the sun and moon displayed above, filling heaven and earth. Only thus might they repay one ten-thousandth of the immense imperial bounty and fulfill the intention of the presiding examiners who selected them. If they esteem and pursue only salary and rank, there will ultimately be no limit to their ambitions. The responsible officials will apply their standards in judging them afterward; it will not be merely a matter of remaining in obscurity [?]. When favors bestowed are generous but repayment meager, when men welcomed as worthy are dismissed as base, when they depart in honor but return in disgrace—what is one to say of them?

An ancient saying declares: “A journey of ten thousand li begins with a half-step.” The singing of “Deer Calling” is indeed the first half-step toward service at court, and the beginning of the signs that foretell esteem or disregard, honor or disgrace. If the eight classes of musical instruments are not in harmony, the finest music cannot be complete; if water and fire do not accumulate, light and flame cannot spread widely. Ji… [?]

title: 嘉靖二十五年廣東鄉試錄
text:
齧善走未若騏驥之良唐虞
之廷不厭盛德之彙萬斛也
竊有全望於爾諸士子也幸
相與勗之云爾
直隸安慶府望江縣儒學敎
諭蕭萬斛謹序
punctuated:
齧善走，未若騏驥之良。唐虞之廷，不厭盛德之彙。萬斛也，竊有全望於爾諸士子也，幸相與勗之云爾。
直隸安慶府望江縣儒學敎諭蕭萬斛謹序。
translation_en:
…though swift at running [?], cannot equal the excellence of fine thoroughbreds. The courts of Tang and Yu never tired of gathering men of eminent virtue. I, Wanhu, place my fullest hopes in you scholars, and ask that you encourage one another in your efforts. That is all I wish to say.
Preface respectfully written by Xiao Wanhu, Instructor of the Confucian School of Wangjiang County, Anqing Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region.
